packet_dag.terminal_condition: The public One Time landing page renders in the One Time black/yellow English-only scope, mounts One Time Helper, avoids BNA language/nav/dropdown bleed, and stores helper threads under one_time_mishnah_class.

title: One Time Public Brand And Helper Isolation

reasons: The operator identified a concrete One Time public brand leak: BNA colors and Hebrew/English toggle behavior should not appear.
The operator requested the One Time helper on the actual landing page.
The operator also raised parent/student helper scope and toolbar density, which are captured as child packets rather than mixed into this public landing patch.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time public landing and public helper
likely_external_provider_blockers: None for mounting/scoping the helper and local UI theme.
No email, Telegram, Stripe, billing, access, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, DNS, or external send is approved in this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this public landing/helper isolation patch, create the parent/student helper-scope packet and top-toolbar/filter visual audit packet.

operator_intent_summary: One Time Mishnah must not inherit BNA brand chrome, BNA language controls, or BNA default component colors. The One Time helper should exist on the landing page and be scoped to One Time, while parent/student helper behavior and toolbar/filter density get separate scoped packets.
raw_quotes: there shouldn't be any overlap between The Branding of DNA and one time mishna
the page like flashes that Hebrew English toggle in the BNA colors
there is no Hebrew English it's just in English
the one-time Mission class helper so that also should exist on the actual landing page
scoped for the student their scope for the parents
top toolbar with like these pills that just takes up two space too much space

decisions_captured.decision: Public landing helper isolation can ship first; authenticated parent/student helper scope must be a child packet.
Top toolbar and filter density needs a current-state visual audit before global layout changes.

out_of_scope: No live parent/student login email send.
No billing, payment, Stripe, access grant, password reset, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, WhatsApp, Telegram, DNS, or external-provider write.
No transcript RAG, Rabbi statement retrieval, attendance readback, or billing display implementation in this packet.
No global toolbar/filter/sidebar redesign across Operations, provider, parent, and student routes.
No Hebrew UI for One Time public landing.
affected_surfaces: One Time public select control styling

inspection_targets: public/one-time/index.html has a One Time-specific black/yellow landing page and native region select but did not mount the helper widget.
public/js/bna-bot-widget.js only switches to One Time Helper on member/classroom/provider-participant surfaces.
public/js/app-select.js uses BNA-blue default styling unless a specific surface override exists.
server.js normalizes One Time member surfaces but not One Time public/helper role surface names.
known_blockers: Broader parent/student helper data and transcript retrieval are blocked into a child packet.
Toolbar/filter density requires a current-state visual audit child packet.

trigger_phrases: pills takes up too much space

expanded_phrases.million-dollar app: Stable role-scoped IA, no brand bleed, equal controls, mobile/desktop proof, and no private-data leakage.
expanded_phrases.overlap between branding: One Time public surfaces use black/yellow assets and copy, not BNA cream/navy/teal or BNA language controls.
expanded_phrases.flashes: Shared component styling must be scoped before enhancement appears so first paint and enhanced state are both One Time-themed.
expanded_phrases.helper should exist: The public helper scripts mount on /one-time and display One Time Helper copy.
expanded_phrases.scoped for the student: Student helper transcript/class/library behavior belongs in a later authenticated student packet.
expanded_phrases.scoped for the parents: Parent helper billing/attendance behavior belongs in a later authenticated parent packet.
expanded_phrases.top toolbar: Toolbar/subcategory/filter density belongs in a later visual audit packet with route matrix and screenshots.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the first-party BNA platform helper and route/action registry while scoping the One Time surface by workspace/project and visible copy. Do not introduce external CRM runtime behavior.

requirements.statement: The public One Time landing page must remain English-only and visually scoped to One Time without BNA nav, language, or default dropdown styling.
requirements.expected_result: /one-time first paint and enhanced select state use One Time black/yellow styling and no Hebrew/English toggle.
acceptance_criteria: Landing HTML does not mount shared BNA site nav or language toggle.
Landing HTML sets an explicit One Time app-select surface.
Shared select enhancer contains a One Time-specific dark/yellow style override.

requirements.statement: The One Time public landing page must mount a One Time-scoped helper.
requirements.expected_result: The helper launcher and panel say One Time Helper and describe One Time class/signup support without BNA school goals or admin copy.
acceptance_criteria: Landing HTML loads helper knowledge before the bot widget.
Widget detects One Time public routes and uses One Time public helper copy.
One Time helper body class uses the black/yellow helper theme.

requirements.statement: One Time helper threads must be project-scoped to one_time_mishnah_class.
requirements.expected_result: Assistant surface normalization accepts One Time public/parent/student labels and creates One Time public threads under the One Time project.
acceptance_criteria: Server normalizes one_time_public distinctly from generic public.
Server chooses one_time_mishnah_class for One Time assistant surfaces.
Safe public assistant boundary names One Time public class/signup context.

criteria: Affected route list is limited to /one-time and the assistant chat endpoint.
Current One Time landing, helper widget, select enhancer, and assistant surface normalizer were inspected.
Parent/student helper transcript, attendance, and billing behavior are explicitly out of this implementation batch.
No external send, payment/access, or private-data mutation is approved.
